releases.notes:
**Minecraft 26.3 | Fabric and NeoForge**

Proof-of-concept of an alternative Villager Trading mechanic using a teaching system, to encourage exploration and reduce random grind. Teach librarians, weaponsmiths, toolsmiths, armourers, and fletchers by selling them enchanted items, and they'll use those to learn more trades.

Install one of these to your server's `mods/` folder (or run Open To LAN on a singleplayer world)

- `tradeschool-fabric-26.0.3-beta1.jar` — Fabric (requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api))
- `tradeschool-neoforge-26.0.3-beta1.jar` — NeoForge

TL;DR:

1. Find a decent enchanted book, enchanted weapon, armour, or even just make a basic pickaxe;
2. Hold it and right-click a suitable Villager (eg. Weaponsmith, Librarian, etc.) and sell it to them
3. The Villager should now be able to sell identical items; however, if they are low-skill eg. novice, it will limit the materials and enchantments they can make.
